description:
FILED s523c (Opus 5.5, s524 resume) while running tools/t/sbcl-floor.t.
tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm _build_cached_core prunes EVERY older core of the same pathkey (`glob pcl-<pathkey>-*.core`, unlink all but the new one).  The core NAME carries the SBCL identity (`sbcl --version` + ~/.sbclrc), the pathkey does not -- so two SBCL versions running against ONE tree at the same time delete each other's core: each build prunes the other version's core, and a spawn that resolved the core path just before the prune execs sbcl on a vanished --core and exits 1 with no output.
Measured: `PCL_SBCL_FLOOR=.../sbcl-2.5.2/bin/sbcl prove tools/t/sbcl-floor.t` run beside a 2.6.0 sweep of the SAME worktree: row 4 (Pl/t/tap-exit-01.t) failed 20 rows, every case rc 1 with empty stdout; the same file alone under 2.5.2 passes; the core directory showed the 2.5.2 core (aa88d45a7308) and the 2.6.0 core (c0bbb15c86b1) replacing each other within the minute.
Fix shape: prune only cores of the same pathkey AND the same SBCL identity (put the sbcl stamp in the prune glob, e.g. pcl-<pathkey>-<sbclkey>-<runtimehash>.core, or read the sidecar); a different SBCL's core is pruned only by the orphan rule.  Until then: never run the floor test concurrently with another leg on the same tree (say so in sbcl-floor.t's header).
subject: PCLSbcl's core prune deletes the OTHER SBCL version's core for the same tree: a floor run (PCL_SBCL_FLOOR) beside a 2.6.0 run on one worktree thrashes, spawns exit 1 with no output
